name: Veterinary: canine lateral thoracic radiographs for vertebral heart size (Mendeley ktx4cj55pn)
what: 152 anonymised lateral thoracic radiographs of dogs; a lateral dog thorax shows T1 to L1 and the VHS method itself counts vertebrae from T4
level_truth: none; T4 is the VHS reference vertebra
status: the owner's veterinary direction of 2026-10-20; found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; the only public veterinary spine radiograph set found; the pig set beside it (veterinary_pig_levelcheck) is a lower-limb registration phantom with no spine
licence: CC BY 4.0 (to confirm on the page)
how_to_get: Open https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/ktx4cj55pn and read the licence line and the file list.
Fetch as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py http-get --url U --dest FILE, U being the public-files address the page gives.
